  mp.hp_subscriber_id,
  mp.hp_member_id,
  hc.plan_id,
  
TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY')AS elg_begin_dt,
  TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')AS elg_end_dt,
  mp.maint_effective_dt,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS prem_withhold_source,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS prem_direct_pay,

CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS subsidypercentage,

  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS lis_copay_lvl_id,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS deemed_copay_lvl_id,

mp.business_id_nh,

  'N' AS generate_tc_flg,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS original_prem_direct_pay,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS org_id_nh,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS employee_id,
  MP.broker_id_card_access,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS textoptin 

  FROM mbrprofile.member_profile mp

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_begin_dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012026', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND
hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL

  AND(mp.member_profile_id_nh NOT IN( 
  SELECT member_profile_id_nh 
  FROM rollover_excluded_mbrs)
